- tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4420 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: line 4420 `HEAL_FP = "abcdef012345"` rebinds the module-level `HEAL_FP = "6" * 64` at line 3806, so `_heal_body()` builds a 12-hex fingerprint that `_FP_HEX_RE` rejects and `test_heal_already_fixed_needs_a_trusted_heal_item` fails (`markers_missing` instead of `no_fixed_sibling`).
  WHY: CI check `orchestrate-poll (3)` reports "1 failed, 702 passed", and the rebinding breaks the new-identifier uniqueness rule (§10). Reviewers rated it BLOCKER, which is the highest severity and maps to critical here. Suggested fix is to rename the new constant, for example `HARNESS_HOLD_FP`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:551-598 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the `actions/runs` listing fails or no failed run matches, `run_refs` is empty, yet the judge still dispatches the heal report, logs `outcome=sent`, and posts the hold request.
  WHY: The heal intake skips a run-less report (`scope_unavailable_no_runs`, exit 0, `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:648-665`), so no heal issue is filed and nobody is alerted while the project holds. Reviewers rated it MAJOR, which maps to high here.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:905-920 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In a mixed route, `_mixed_heal_ops` (scripts/unblock_actions.py:695-701) adds a telegram op only when the label is empty, and the skip WARNING only matches text starting "Unblock judge routed #". A skipped report (`WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false`) therefore sends no alert, and a failed dispatch has no telegram op to carry one.
  WHY: The harness half of a mixed verdict is dropped with only a log line, contrary to the README and changelog. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from most reviewers and NIT from z-ai_glm-5_3-flash; the highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:905-908 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `elif jq -e 'any(.ops[]; .op == "heal_report")'` branch fires on any op failure, even when the heal report was sent and only the `hold_request` comment failed.
  WHY: The WARNING wrongly says the heal report could not be sent, so the operator investigates the wrong write. Suggested fix is to guard with `[ "${heal_sent}" != "true" ]`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:425 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `"issue": ("workflow_failure_heal.yml", "unblock_judge.yml")` entry is the first kind with two reporter workflows, and its "issue-kind only" comment could mislead.
  WHY: The change is correct and pinned by a test; the reviewer suggested dropping the finding unless the comment is clarified.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Use `Refs #N` only" (Constraints section; the PR description uses `Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/8048`).
  Expected change site: PR title and description, not part of the diff.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description carries an auto-close keyword for #8048. #8048 is a sub-issue, so the §21 tracking-issue rule is not tripped. The reviewer rates it a NIT and not a defect in the diff.
  severity=NIT | confidence=2
- tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4420 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `HEAL_FP = "abcdef012345"` rebinds the module-level `HEAL_FP = "6" * 64` at line 3806. `_heal_body()` reads the global at call time (lines 3812 and 3814), so bodies carry a 12-hex fingerprint while `HEAL_ITEM` and `HEAL_ORIGINAL` keep the 64-hex value.
  WHY: `_FP_HEX_RE` requires 64 hex, so `heal_already_fixed_candidates` returns `markers_missing` and the test fails at line 3886; CI `orchestrate-poll (3)` reports "1 failed, 702 passed". Rename the constant (e.g. `HARNESS_HOLD_FP`) at lines 4420, 4432, 4436, 4438 and 4500. This also breaks §10.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:`unblock_send_heal_report` (actions/runs listing fallback) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the listing fails or returns no matching failed runs, the payload has empty `run_refs`, yet the report is dispatched, `outcome=sent` is logged and `heal_sent=true` is set; the `hold_request` comment is then posted.
  WHY: `_heal_report_claimed_no_runs` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh ~648-660) skips it with `scope_unavailable_no_runs`, files nothing and raises no alert. Fix: require non-empty `run_refs` after `build-issue-payload`, else return 1 with `reason=runs_unavailable`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh (~911-920, ~905-908) with scripts/unblock_actions.py:695-701 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In a `mixed` route `_mixed_heal_ops` emits only the `heal_report` op, plus a telegram op only when the label is empty. If `WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false` skips the report, or dispatch fails, there is no telegram op to carry the warning.
  WHY: The harness half of a mixed verdict is dropped with only a log line, contrary to the README and changelog.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:~905-908 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `elif jq -e 'any(.ops[]; .op == "heal_report")'` branch fires on any op failure, even when the report was sent and only `hold_request` failed.
  WHY: The WARNING wrongly says the report could not be sent. Fix: guard with `[ "${heal_sent}" != "true" ]`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:425 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `"issue": ("workflow_failure_heal.yml", "unblock_judge.yml")` entry is the first kind with two reporter workflows, and the "issue-kind only" comment could mislead.
  WHY: It does not fail; the change is correct and pinned by a test. Drop unless the comment is clarified.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 items): in scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_send_heal_report`, check `jq -e '(.run_refs // []) | length > 0'` and return 1 with `reason=runs_unavailable`. In tests/test_unblock_judge.py `_harness_judge_env`, return `WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED: "true"` and empty OIDC variables. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4420 (vs 3806; consumed at 3812, 3814; failing call site 3884, assertion 3886) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new P3b block rebinds module-level `HEAL_FP`. `_heal_body()` reads it at call time, so runtime bodies carry a 12-hex fingerprint while `HEAL_ITEM` and `HEAL_ORIGINAL` keep the 64-hex value. `_FP_HEX_RE` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:495) accepts only 64 hex, so `markers_missing` is returned instead of `no_fixed_sibling`. This also violates §10.
  WHY: `orchestrate-poll (3)` fails the test ("1 failed, 702 passed") so the `CI / lint` gate cannot pass. Rename the new constant (e.g. `HARNESS_HOLD_FP`) at lines 4420, 4432, 4436, 4438 and 4500.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:905-908 (reached from `telegram)` at line 883) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `elif` fires on any ops failure in a run with a `heal_report` op, regardless of whether the report was sent; `heal_sent` (set at line 857) is not consulted.
  WHY: When the report is sent and the `hold_request` write (lines 876-881) fails, the operator is paged with "could not send the harness heal report" and looks in the wrong place.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:911-920 with scripts/unblock_actions.py:695-701 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The skip WARNING is emitted only for a `telegram` op whose text starts "Unblock judge routed #", produced only by `_harness_ops` (unblock_actions.py:689). `_mixed_heal_ops` adds a WARNING telegram only when the label is empty (699-700), and no mixed-capable verdict branch adds one.
  WHY: For a mixed verdict whose report is skipped or whose dispatch fails, neither WARNING (911-920, 905-908) is reached, so the harness half is dropped with only a log line and nobody is paged, contrary to the README and changelog.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:546-556, 570-576, 853-863, 864-882 with scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:866-908 and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:648-665 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The judge never checks that the payload names at least one run. `run_refs` comes only from `select_failed_runs`, and `validate_payload` accepts an `issue`-kind payload with no runs (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2172-2178), so the dispatch is sent, `heal_sent` becomes true and the hold request is posted.
  WHY: The intake skips the report with `scope_unavailable_no_runs` and exit 0, files no heal issue and sends no CRITICAL alert, so the poller enters `validation_harness_hold` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15939-15948) waiting for a fix nobody will deliver.
